bulletins.headline: IMD Red Warning: Severe Cyclonic Storm over North Tamil Nadu coast near Ennore and Chennai
bulletins.text: Extremely heavy rainfall exceeding 200mm and gale winds of 105 km/h forecast across Tiruvallur, Ennore, Kamarajar Port, Chennai Port, and Sriperumbudur industrial belt over next 96 hours.

bulletins.headline: IMD Orange Warning: Heavy monsoon rain affecting Bengaluru Whitefield ICD and Bidadi highway approaches
bulletins.text: Localized arterial waterlogging likely around Whitefield ICD, Hosur highway, and Bidadi industrial corridors.
